jobs.description:
For a well-known company with sites in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for a Night Shift Operator for the site in Bredene.

As a OPERATOR NIGHTSHIFT in the Bredene region, you will be responsible for:

  • Receiving deliveries of ingredients;
  • Setting up, starting, operating, and changing over a production line;
  • Ensuring a smooth handover between shifts;
  • Monitoring production orders;
  • Recording production data;
  • Cleaning and maintaining the machines;
  • Troubleshooting operational issues yourself and notifying the technical department in case of more complex technical failures;
  • Assisting the packing team when required.
As an OPERATOR NIGHTSHIFT in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You have a solid background as an operator;
  • You are motivated to work in the food industry within a production environment;
  • You are willing to work in a fixed night shift (21:00 – 05:00);
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client located in WESTENDE we are looking for a ROAD WORKER!

Our client is a well-known contractor who does assignments for the government and private sector.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and work outdoors? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE this is your job:

  • You are responsible for sewerage works;
  • You are responsible for placing embroidery;
  • Construction of cycle paths, roads and car parks;
  • Placing environmental pavements;
  • Placing roundabouts and refuges;
  • Placing vowels and paving stones;

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE you can find yourself in the following

  • You speak Englisch or Dutch
  • You are handy and like to work outside
  • No study requirements - motivation is what we need!

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CNC SETTER.

Our client is a technical and innovative company active in the manufacturing industry. They offer a family-oriented working environment and are committed to investing in both technology and their employees.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Setting up and programming CNC machines (mainly 3-axis lathes);
  • Producing unique pieces based on technical drawings (limited series production);
  • Setting up and programming CNC machines;
  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings prepared by the engineering department;
  • Measuring finished parts and comparing them with the technical drawings;
  • Checking the quality of the manufactured parts;
  • Working mainly with 3-axis lathes.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience setting up CNC-controlled machines;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings, machining techniques, measurement techniques, and determining tolerances;
  • You can operate an overhead crane or are willing to learn this internally;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For a family-owned company located in Oudenburg, we are looking for a WORKSHOP CARPENTER.

Do you enjoy making and installing windows? We got you!

As a WINDOW INSTALLER in the Oudenburg region, your tasks will include:

  • Manufacturing and installing wooden balustrades and windows;
  • Reading technical plans and measuring the correct dimensions on wooden structures;
  • Operating CNC machines and specific woodworking machines;
  • Producing window frames;
  • Responsible for the installation of carpentry work;
  • Making and installing custom-made windows and doors (aluminium, PVC, wood, etc.).
As a WINDOW INSTALLER in Oudenburg, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have experience as a carpenter;
  • You speak Dutch or English
  • Physical work does not scare you!

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Installing and assembling screw pumps, water treatment installations, bridges, and other structures on-site;
  • Ensuring the commissioning of these installations or carrying out maintenance work;
  • Performing necessary repairs and renovation works when required;
  • Working mainly in Belgium, with occasional assignments in the Netherlands, France, and Germany;
  • Staying overnight in hotels when required;
  • Working with various welding machines and, when necessary, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have a technically oriented diploma with knowledge of welding techniques;
  • You are willing to occasionally stay overnight in a hotel, as the projects are carried out on different locations;
  • You are not afraid of outdoor work and large constructions;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently and take initiative;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-established company with years of experience in providing sustainable energy solutions. With a strong passion for technology and technical installations, they are committed to helping build a greener future. Would you like to contribute to the transition towards renewable energy in Belgium and neighboring countries? Then keep reading!

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN in the Veurne region, your responsibilities will include:

  • Connecting solar panel installations, home battery systems, and/or EV charging stations;
  • Installing the inverter and providing the required AC and DC cabling according to industry standards;
  • Connecting the AC and DC cables to the inverter;
  • Making any necessary modifications to the electrical distribution board;
  • Completing the single-line electrical diagram to ensure the technical inspection can be carried out;
  • Commissioning the complete installation and providing the customer with clear instructions and explanations on its operation.

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You have a strong electrical background (experience with solar panels is an advantage but can be taught);
  • You are able to read and interpret technical drawings with ease;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You have a strong focus on safety and always follow the correct procedures and regulations.

For a well-known company with sites in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for an OPERATOR for the site in Bredene.

As an Operator (2-shift system) in the Bredene region, you will be responsible for:

  • Receiving deliveries of ingredients;
  • Setting up, starting, operating, and changing over a production line;
  • Ensuring a smooth handover between shifts;
  • Monitoring production orders;
  • Recording production data;
  • Cleaning and maintaining the machines;
  • Troubleshooting operational issues yourself and notifying the technical department in case of more complex technical failures;
  • Assisting the packing team when required.
As an Operator (2-shift system) in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You have solid experience as an Operator;
  • You are motivated to work in the food industry within a production environment;
  • You are willing to work in 2 SHIFTS.
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in VEURNE, we are looking for an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN.

Our client is a well-known company in Veurne, responsible for electrical projects from A to Z.

As an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN in VEURNE, your responsibilities include:

  • Installing electrical installations in the residential and industrial sectors;
  • Connecting electrical cabinets;
  • Laying cables, chasing and cutting;
  • Carrying out work based on plans and bills of quantities;
  • Managing a team of 2–3 people;
  • Executing projects from A to Z.
As an INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICIAN in OSTEND, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have relevant experience as an industrial and/or residential electrician;
  • You hold a Category B driving licence;
  • Physical work is not a problem for you;
  • You speak Dutch, English, or French.

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a CHARGING STATION TECHNICIAN.

This company is responsible for large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

A selection of your responsibilities as a CHARGING STATION ELECTRICIAN in the Veurne region:

  • Installation and commissioning of new charging stations;
  • Early detection of potential issues;
  • Checking the correct operation of installations;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving malfunctions;
  • Accurate and correct administrative processing of your interventions;
  • Carrying out inspections and resolving faults;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams to deliver customer-oriented and innovative solutions.

What our client in the Veurne region is looking for in a new colleague as a CHARGING STATION TECHNICIAN:

  • You have completed a training in electricity and/or have equivalent experience;
  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English (very well);
  • You have a technical background, as well as experience with charging stations, or a strong interest in this field;
  • You are motivated to become part of a growing company.

Our client is a well-established company with years of experience in providing sustainable energy solutions. With a strong passion for technology and technical installations, they are committed to helping build a greener future. For our client in the OSTEND region, we are looking for an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN.

Our client is an international leader in high-tech solutions for the defence industry. The company develops autonomous underwater drones that detect, identify, and neutralise naval mines.

As an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN in the OSTEND region, you will play a key role in repairing, testing, and validating electronic assemblies.

Thanks to your expertise, the electronic systems of our underwater drones operate reliably and meet the highest quality standards.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Diagnosing faults in electronic assemblies;
  • Repairing PCBs at component level;
  • Performing precision soldering (SMD and through-hole);
  • Repairing electronic components according to established quality standards;
  • Accurately documenting analysis and repair results;
  • Supporting the testing, validation, and rework of electronic assemblies.
As an ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN in the OSTEND region, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

  • You have strong knowledge of electronics;
  • You have experience in electronic diagnostics and component-level repairs;
  • You have experience with SMD and through-hole soldering techniques;
  • You are able to read and interpret technical schematics and drawings;
  • You are computer literate (Linux and MS Office);
  • Knowledge of IPC 610, IPC 620, IPC 7711 and IPC 7721 is a plus;
  • You have a good command of English; knowledge of French is an advantage;
  • Administrative follow-up does not scare you.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

As an Administrative & Operations Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of daily operational activities across payments, cash management, trade finance, and client administration.

Client Details

Join a well-established international financial institution with a strong presence across EMEA. Known for its expertise in corporate banking, financial services, and global markets, the company offers a collaborative environment where innovation, operational excellence, and long-term client relationships are at the heart of its success.

Description

• Process and monitor domestic and international payments.
• Manage incoming client requests and internal inquiries via email and phone.
• Support administrative follow-up of banking operations and client files.
• Assist with Trade Finance and Guarantee-related transactions.
• Maintain and update client documentation and e-banking agreements.
• Perform reconciliations, operational controls, and account maintenance tasks.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and KYC requirements.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects.
• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset (french big plus)
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.
• Strong communication skills and a client-focused mindset.
• Previous experience in administration, operations, banking support, or financial services is a plus.

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

This Junior Administrative Assistant role offers the opportunity to support daily office operations, manage communication flows, and assist various departments with key administrative tasks. It's an ideal first job for someone eager to learn, grow, and develop strong organisational and professional skills in a dynamic environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well‑established and dynamic company located in Brussels. They offer a stimulating work environment where professionals can grow, develop new skills, and build a long‑term career. Due to continued expansion, they are looking for a motivated Administrative Assistant to join their team.

Description

As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting daily office operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
• Preparing and formatting documents, reports, and presentations
• Supporting various departments with administrative tasks
• Handling agendas, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments
• Ensuring proper filing and data management
• Assisting with internal communication and basic logistics
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient functioning of the office

• You are graduated in Administration, Office Management, Languages, Business, or equivalent
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Organized, detail‑oriented, and eager to take initiative
• Communicative, proactive, and capable of working in a fast‑paced environment
• Motivated to kickstart your career in administration and open to learning on the job

This Junior HR Assistant position gives the opportunity to support core HR processes, from recruitment coordination to employee administration and onboarding. It's the ideal first step for someone who wants to develop strong HR skills and grow within a dynamic, people‑focused environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is an international and people‑oriented company based in Brussels. They are known for their strong company culture, internal mobility, and commitment to developing talent. To support their growing HR department, they are looking for an enthusiastic Junior HR Assistant ready to discover the world of Human Resources.

Omschrijving

As a Junior HR Assistant, you will support the HR team across a variety of tasks, giving you a broad introduction to the field. Your responsibilities will include:

• Assisting with the recruitment process: job postings, screening CVs, scheduling interviews
• Supporting the onboarding of new employees
• Handling HR administration: contracts, personnel files, absences, certificates
• Preparing HR documents and ensuring updated employee data
• Helping with payroll preparation by collecting and verifying information
• Participating in HR projects such as employer branding, training coordination, or wellbeing initiatives
• Being a point of contact for employees, providing clear and friendly support

• You graduated in HR, Psychology, Office Management, Business, or a related field
• Eager to start your career and develop strong HR skills
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Skilled in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
• Organized, communicative, and service‑minded
• Proactive, eager to learn, and comfortable handling confidential information
• A real team player who enjoys working with people

Then this job is definitely for you! 
 
Responsibilities

 
• 
Responsible for unloading trucks

 
• 
Placing pork on the production line and ensuring smooth workflow

 
•

• 
Alternating between all the above tasks – no day is the same

 
•

Working in a cooled environment of approximately 7°C

A physical, varied job in a production environment appeals to you

 
• 
Early mornings are not a problem for you

 
• 
You are a team player and contribute to efficient production

 
• 
You are flexible and willing to work until the job is done

 
• 
Experience in production or logistics

 
• 
Experience in the food sector is a plus

 
• 
Comfortable working in a cooled environment of 7°C

 
• 
Fluent in English and/or Dutch and/or Romanian

 
• 
You have your own transport

You are responsible for the correct handling and shipment of incoming goods.

You will follow a pick list to pack and sort the goods according to their destination.

You communicate well in English and/or Dutch.

 
• 
You are available to work from 08:00 to 16:15.

 
• 
Physical work is no issue for you.

 
•

•
